name: Discount Rules, Coupon management system – Discountify
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Discountify is the ultimate WooCommerce discount and dynamic pricing plugin that helps to increase sales and revenue for your store. With this, you can set up a variety of discount rules to drive conversions and gradually boost revenue.

Discountify allows the users to create smart, dynamic pricing strategies customized based on the type of the customers and audience. Whether it’s personalized discounts, time-limited offers, or category-based promotions, this plugin gives you total control over your pricing. Maximize sales, increase customer loyalty, and outperform your competition by providing versatile discount and coupon systems.

Take full advantage of advanced discount features to give your customers irresistible offers that keep them coming back. Discountify makes it easy to create custom promotions that fit your store’s needs, driving both immediate and long-term growth.

⭐️ Need Any Help? 👉 Contact Us.
⭐️ Check Live Demo 👉 Discountify Demo

Core Features of Discountify

  • Set Discount Rules
  • Storewide Discounts
  • Fixed Discounts
  • Percentage Discounts
  • Discount on total Cart
  • Buy X Get X – Pro
  • Buy X Get Y – Pro
  • Buy 1 Get 1 Free – Pro
  • Free Product or Gift – Pro
  • Conditional Discounts – Pro
  • Buy 2 Get 1 at 50% OFF – Pro
  • Buy From Category A get Discount from Category B – Pro
  • Discount on Total Spend – Pro
  • Customer Specific Pricing – Pro
  • Bulk Pricing – Pro
  • Dynamic Pricing – Pro

Why should you start using this plugin?

Discount Rules, Dynamic Pricing for WooCommerce – Discountify!
With its user-friendly interface and powerful features, Discountify is the lightweight yet effective plugin you need to attract customers, boost conversions, and drive revenue growth. Simple to set up, but loaded with the tools to maximize your store’s potential.

👉 All Products or Storewide offers – Apply percentage or fixed discount in all products
👉 Buy X Get X discount – Get more sales with Buy X, Get X offer in your WooCommerce store! This lets your customers grab a discount or even a free product when they purchase a certain quantity. It’s an lucrative offer that encourages bulk purchasing and boosts your revenue instantly!
👉 Buy X Get Y discount – Integrate Buy X, Get Y discount rule with a few clicks! Reward customers who purchase a specific product (X) by giving them a discount on another product (Y). This cross-selling strategy drives higher cart value and keeps customers coming back for more!
👉 Free Product or Gift – Offer free products or gifts from your store using this feature and get more sales and make a loyal customer base. Offering a free gift is one of the most powerful ways to entice new customers and keep them coming back for more. It’s a proven strategy to boost repeat purchases and drive consistent sales growth in your online store!
👉 Conditional Discounts – Don’t want to offer discounts to a mass audience? Use this plugin to create conditional discounts and set a variety of rules. Implement a special pricing strategy where discounts or special offers are applied to purchases based on specific conditions or criteria being met.
👉 Category Combination – Want to increase sales by combining product categories? Set smart discount rules with our plugin. For example, offer a discount on sunglasses when a customer buys a shirt. Reward smart shopping with targeted deals!
👉 Fixed Discounts – Use this feature to encourage customers to buy more—while keeping your profit margins strong.
👉 Percentage discounts – It will Replace “Sale” badge on every sales product with percentage of discount. Set the percentage however you want.
👉 Discount on Total Spend – Giving additional discounts on total discount will encourage your audience to buy more from you. You can now integrate this option with a few clicks.
👉 Customer Specific Pricing – If you have some loyal customers, using this feature, you can give special discounts only for those customers.
👉 Free Shipping based on Cart Amount/Quantity – This feature allows you to offer free shipping based on the cart value.
👉 Bulk Pricing – Bulk discounts help you clear out stock faster by offering incentives to customers. For example, give a 10% discount when they buy 10 or more of a product.
👉 Dynamic Pricing – It allows you to set up promotions and dynamic pricing for your WooCommerce store with ease and precision.
👉 Discount on total Cart – Add Cart Discount based on cart total amount. It increases the conversions by encouraging customers to buy from you.
👉 Shipping Cost based On cart total or amount – Offer exclusive discounts on shipping based on cart total or quantity.
👉 Discount on First Order – You can make your customers feel special when they are placing their first order. It also makes a strong connection with your customers.
👉 Discount based on purchase history – If customers frequently purchase from your store, it’s a great idea to offer additional discounts based on their buying history. It’s easy to integrate this system with Discountify.

📌 [Before writing any review, Please be aware that, Discountify is still in its initial stage]

More features are on the way! You can see the Changelog for more update. Join us on social media to get the latest update and offers.

🔥 WHAT’S NEXT

If you like Discountify, then consider checking out other WordPress Plugins made by the same team:

🔔 MemberHub – Create Members for WordPress and WooCommerce and Boost your sales
🔔 Filter Plus – It is a WordPress and WooCommerce Product Filter Plugin that allows users to add multiple filtering features like filter by Ratings, Tags, Price Range, Custom Fields etc.
🔔 Quicker – Convert Your Browsers into Buyers and Maximize Conversions

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/discountify directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Discountify -> Rules screen to configure discount rules
sections.faq:
= Is it compatible with all WordPress themes? =

We have tested all the popular themes. And we believe, it will work with your theme if that has been well developed for WordPress and WooComerce. If you face any issue, drop us a message on our support link. Our team will take care of the compatibility issue.

= Are all the features are available for free?=
Some of the features are for free and some are available in the pro version.

= Is there any dependancy of this plugin?=
Discountify is a stand alone WooCommerce plugin and it doesn’t require any third-party software installation.

= Can I set my own custom rules for discounts?=
Yes, you can add custom discount rules and we have a dedicated feature for that.

= Can I generate coupon codes with a this plugin?=
Yes, Discountify is a WordPress coupon generator that lets you easily create and manage custom discount codes, enhancing WooCommerce with features like first-purchase discounts and purchase history-based offers.
